company.name: Project Liberté
company.shortDescription: Project Liberté develops blockchain infrastructure and tools that support decentralized applications and digital asset networks.
company.description:
The journey of Project Liberte has been nothing short of remarkable. It began with a vision to revolutionize the world of social media, blockchain technology, and enhance the overall well-being of humanity. Liberte Team has done a deep research in the market trends, understanding the needs and requirements of users, and identifying the gaps in the current
digital landscape. Over the course of several months, we meticulously assembled an expert team consisting of talented professionals, including developers, designers, data scientists, and marketing specialists. The magnitude of Project Liberte is unparalleled. With its ambitious goal of catering to every individual and country globally, it has required an immense amount of resources, time, and dedication from all team members. Our team has spent thousands of hours working tirelessly to ensure that each functionality of the platform is designed and developed with precision and care. We strived to make sure that every aspect of the project contributes to creating a holistic, life-changing experience.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $15,000,000, or 75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $5,000,000, representing 25% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,000,000 to $25,000,000, a 3.13x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 19 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
